derivation:
by
  apply Set.projIcc_of_right_le
  simpa only [coe_one, mul_one, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 1 + (θ : ℝ)), one_mul, ← one_add_one_eq_two, add_le_add_iff_left] using θ.2.2
